question.text: In the PM's dealing room, mobile phones and external communication devices:

answer.text: Are NOT allowed; only dedicated recorded lines and authorized emails
Are allowed only for senior staff

explanation.text: The Logic: Dealing-room rules prohibit non-recorded devices; only recorded phones and authorized email. The Trap: No time-of-day or seniority exceptions exist. Cross-Exam Context: Same operational control in III-C. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Physical mobile-locker at dealing-room entry and CCTV review are best practice.
